title: Event Definition
description: Schema for BitBrat internal event type definitions (config/events/*.yaml)

description.description: Human-readable description of what this event represents

version.description: Event schema version number (increment on breaking changes)

category.description: Event flow direction: ingress (incoming only), egress (outgoing only), or bidirectional (both)

deprecated.description: Whether this event type is deprecated and should not be used for new implementations

replacedBy.description: If deprecated, the event type that replaces this one

metadata.description: Additional metadata for observability and governance

createdBy.description: Author or team who created this event definition

createdAt.description: Date when this event was first defined (YYYY-MM-DD)

owningTeam.description: Team responsible for maintaining this event definition

relatedEvents.description: Related event types (e.g., dm.message.v1 relates to dm.sent.v1)

schema.description: Optional JSON Schema for validating event payload structure

properties.description: Expected fields in the event payload

required.description: Required fields in the event payload

examples.description: Direct message sent between two users
Message sent to a public or private channel
User started typing in a channel
